content.description: Cross-sectional diagram of receiver/dryer assembly showing sight glass, receiver, and refrigerant flow

items: OPERATE AIR CONDITIONER AT MAXIMUM COOLING FOR A FEW MINUTES

CHECK AMOUNT OF REFRIGERANT
Observe the sight glass on the receiver.

rows: Check for leak with gas leak tester
No bubbles present in sight glass
No temperature difference between compressor inlet and outlet
System is empty or nearly empty
Evacuate and charge system. Then check for leak with gas leak tester
Temperature between compressor inlet and outlet is noticeably different
Immediately after the air conditioner is turned off, refrigerant in sight glass stays clear
Discharge the excess refrigerant to specified amount
When the air conditioner is turned off, refrigerant foams and then stays clear

content.description: Diagram showing charging hose connections to refrigeration system, with connections to gauge manifold and compressor

content.text: Fittings for attaching the manifold gauge set are located on the compressor service valves.

items: CLOSE BOTH HAND VALVES OF MANIFOLD GAUGE SET

INSTALL CHARGING HOSES OF GAUGE SET TO SERVICE VALVES
Connect the low pressure hose to the suction service valve and the high pressure hose to the discharge service valve. Tighten the hose nuts by hand.

content.text: Do not apply compressor oil to the seat of the connection.
